title: Idea probes by layer
caption: Cross-validated balanced accuracy of multinomial probes for the realised idea class, pooled over the open path-search and weighted shortest-path tasks (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, 300 baseline samples per task). Probes on the first generated tokens recover only task identity (0.433); the mean over tokens 1-32 is decodable at 0.64-0.71 against 0.39-0.43 for shuffled labels, flatly across depth. Layers 29-31 were used for all interventions.
summary: Early tokens carry no idea information; a 32-token window does, flat across layers.

title: Temperature sweep: correctness vs ideas
caption: Temperature sweep in the influence arm (n = 150 per point; T = 0.7 is the baseline draw). Correctness collapses above T = 1.0 while idea entropy rises by at most 0.46 bits; top-k = 10 at T = 1.6 keeps code parseable but not correct. The best temperature that keeps at least 80% of baseline pass rate (pooled) is T = 0.7.
image_gen_detailed_description: Two side-by-side panels sharing the x-axis 'Sampling temperature' with ticks 0.7, 1.0, 1.3, 1.6, 2.0. Left panel title 'Open path-search task', right panel 'Weighted shortest-path task'. In each panel three line series against temperature: 'Oracle pass rate' (left y-axis, 0 to 1), 'Degenerate share (syntax error or no code)' (left y-axis, 0 to 1), and 'Idea entropy (bits)' (right y-axis, 0 to 2). open path-search task: pass rate T=0.7: 0.673, T=1.0: 0.613, T=1.3: 0.320, T=1.6: 0.007, T=2.0: 0.000; degenerate share T=0.7: 0.000, T=1.0: 0.000, T=1.3: 0.280, T=1.6: 0.980, T=2.0: 1.000; idea entropy T=0.7: 1.175, T=1.0: 1.278, T=1.3: 1.288, T=1.6: 0.811, T=2.0: 0.000; plus single unconnected markers at T=1.6 for 'top-k = 10': pass 0.227, degenerate 0.107, entropy 1.366. weighted shortest-path task: pass rate T=0.7: 0.380, T=1.0: 0.233, T=1.3: 0.067, T=1.6: 0.000, T=2.0: 0.000; degenerate share T=0.7: 0.000, T=1.0: 0.007, T=1.3: 0.360, T=1.6: 1.000, T=2.0: 1.000; idea entropy T=0.7: 0.916, T=1.0: 1.165, T=1.3: 1.377, T=1.6: 1.000, T=2.0: 0.000; plus single unconnected markers at T=1.6 for 'top-k = 10': pass 0.040, degenerate 0.213, entropy 1.301. Draw a horizontal dotted line on the pass-rate axis at the eligibility threshold: 0.560 in the left panel and 0.299 in the right panel. Note: at T=2.0 idea entropy is 0 because no output (open task) or one output in 150 (weighted task) contains a classifiable program. The point to see: pass rate falls steeply and degeneration rises from T=1.0 on, while idea entropy gains only a few tenths of a bit before collapsing.
summary: Temperature trades correctness for little idea diversity.

title: Flattening directions select DFS
caption: Idea composition under the two 'flattening' directions (layers 29-31, prompt-final token plus first 64 generated tokens; n = 150 per bar). Instead of evening out the two menu ideas, the directions select the minority idea: DFS on the open task, BFS on the weighted task, where BFS-style programs are usually incorrect.

title: Novelty direction is not a dial
caption: Dose-response of the cross-task novelty direction (extracted from five non-path tasks, added at layers 29-31; n = 150 per point, α = 0 is the baseline). Atypicality of the realised idea is not monotone in strength (Spearman 0.49 and −0.26 against a required 0.8), so the direction fails as a dial even though it detects novelty requests with AUROC 1.0.
